# Editor fixture sources and licences

**Synthetic (EDITOR-01 … 20, except 12/13)** — generated by `qa/scripts/editor-fixtures.mjs` (Chromium/Skia print,
LibreOffice via python-docx, MuPDF, pdf-lib-free). All text is invented; no real people, numbers or documents. Licence: the
repository's own (generated content, no third-party material). Each text fixture has deliberate spelling mistakes; the
manifest (`manifest.json`) lists them with the correction the real-user matrix applies.

EDITOR-05 (the AcroForm) is built with MuPDF and then re-written with pikepdf so its radio buttons form one group with named choices (Student / Individual / Family), as real forms do.

**EDITOR-12 / 13** — copies of `qa/real-user-fixtures/DOCUMENT-02` and `DOCUMENT-07`: fake scans (JPEG page images) made by
`qa/scripts/real-user-fixtures.py`.

**Public documents (`public/`)** — used to test the engine against producers other than ours. Fetched on 2026-10-18.

| File | Source | Producer (from the file) | Licence / terms |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fw9.pdf` | https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fw9.pdf — IRS Form W-9 | Adobe Designer 6.5 (AcroForm) | U.S. federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105) |
| `f1040es.pdf` | https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f1040es.pdf — IRS Form 1040-ES | Antenna House PDF Output Library | U.S. federal government work, public domain |
| `table.pdf` | https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG20/Techniques/working-examples/PDF20/table.pdf — W3C WAI PDF example | Adobe PDF Library 9.0 / Acrobat PDFMaker 9.0 for Word | © W3C, published under the W3C Document License (copying and redistribution with attribution allowed); kept for testing only |

None of these files is modified by the editor tests (they are read; edited copies go to `qa/fidelity/_work/`, which is not committed).
